text: **Current progress: eight of ten substantial findings accepted.** [R014](frontier/findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) is the newest accepted finding. [I80](frontier/iterations/i80-geometric-flows-computation-discovery.md) proposes compact velocity, pressure and solenoidal rapid forcing for fluid computation. [I85](frontier/reviews/i85-compact-solenoidal-computation-r2.md) passes its original proof without repairs, and parent evidence reproduction passes. [I86](frontier/reviews/i86-compact-solenoidal-computation-novelty-r3.md) completes the relevant-companion comparison and classifies C80 as **technical**, via a complete moving compact-Euler-template reduction. The original proof PASS is retained; no finding is added. Its frozen verifier’s inventory-sorting failure and successful read-only correction are both preserved. [I83](frontier/iterations/i83-catalan-finite-measure.md) passes the original I81 technical proofs without repairs, but leaves Catalan’s finite irrationality exponent unproved and unrefuted after two developed routes; parent evidence reproduction passes and that branch is parked. [I84](frontier/iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) proves abstract nonisomorphism for the actual close-algebra examples. [I87](frontier/reviews/i87-abstract-close-algebras-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I88](frontier/iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md) gives technical support-size and qualitative rank bounds, but leaves the quantitative rank target open; parent evidence checks pass. [I90](frontier/iterations/i90-anchored-rank-approximation.md) passes the original I88 proofs without repairs and proposes an exponential rank bound through weighted pairwise continuation and clipped discrepancy transfer. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I92](frontier/reviews/i92-anchored-rank-approximation-r2.md) passes the original Q90 proof and all stated variants without repairs; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I93](frontier/reviews/i93-anchored-rank-approximation-novelty-r3.md) classifies Q90 as technical through a complete source-operation/Auerbach/TV reduction; parent evidence reproduction passes. The original proof pass is retained without a count increment. [I94](frontier/iterations/i94-topology-transformation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical nonextension and even-stabilization threshold deductions; parent evidence reproduction passes. Its sharp relative involution target on V#2(S²×S²) remains unproved and unrefuted. [I97](frontier/iterations/i97-relative-involution-stabilization.md) passes original A/B without repairs and adds author-level technical restrictions on the residual product geometry and an exact cut-defect budget; parent evidence replay passes. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted. [I100](frontier/iterations/i100-defect-tolerant-topology-obstruction.md) passes original C/D/E and the scoped complement/Whitney claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new technical residual presentation and periodic localization do not improve the stabilization bound, and an exact algebraic counterexample blocks rank-only tensor extensions. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted; the branch is parked pending new geometric control. [I103](frontier/iterations/i103-algebraic-complexity-discovery.md) gives complete author-level positive-characteristic rational hitting lists and an every-field 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent transfer, both classified technical by its concrete source-operation comparison. [I106](frontier/iterations/i106-positive-characteristic-imm.md) passes all original constructions and scoped counterexamples without repairs and independently confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. [I109](frontier/iterations/i109-modular-imm-rank.md) passes all original I106 partials and scoped obstructions without repairs and confirms their technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible periodic minors and exact excursion-rank decomposition remain too small for the circuit target. The full excursion degeneration has exponentially deficient rank in characteristic two; this is not an upper bound on full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved and unrefuted, and this construction branch is parked. [I112](frontier/iterations/i112-inverse-boundary-discovery.md) gives author-level technical cap-transfer, physical-jet lifting and local rigidity results, plus a known-collar uniqueness reduction and scoped gauge/boundary-cost obstructions. Parent evidence replay passes. Arbitrary same-patch recovery of both Lamé coefficients remains unproved/unrefuted; the physical augmented jet space has dimension 32 versus 36 for unrestricted system jets. [I115](frontier/iterations/i115-physical-elasticity-continuation.md) preserves two original failures: G112 standalone invertibility needs boundary on every component, and R112 equal-coefficient normalization fails when the equal coefficient is λ=0. The surviving scoped claims pass. New cap construction, fourth-order physical moment closure and conditional comparison rigidity remain author-level technical results. Parent evidence and an independently rebuilt 165×165 determinant certificate pass. [I118](frontier/iterations/i118-physical-quotient-angular.md) passes original I115 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new author-level technical results give a sharp physical quotient norm criterion, a local evaluation representative and conditional frontier continuation. The nonnormal physical boundary symbol and an uncontrolled trace-kernel component prevent importing the scalar estimate. [I121](frontier/iterations/i121-physical-transfer-bound.md) passes original I118 without repairs at its stated scopes; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work gives frozen accretivity, exact quotient coordinates and the physical boundary Cauchy-defect formula. Neither developed attempt bounds the actual continued flux uniformly. P112 remains unproved/unrefuted; both physical-transfer and expanding-Runge branches are parked pending a new mechanism. [I124](frontier/iterations/i124-fractal-incidence-discovery.md) passes original I121 N1–N16/F1–F12 without repairs at their stated scopes and confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its fresh planar pinned-distance target remains unproved/unrefuted. Fibrewise reconstruction and mass-sensitive tube bounds are author-level technical bridges; an actual Frostman construction defeats a proposed uniform local-energy bound, not pinned positivity. [I127](frontier/iterations/i127-diagonal-pinned-distance.md) passes the original R1 conclusion and other scoped claims, while preserving failure of the arbitrary-cutoff approximate-identity inference; normalized cutoffs supply the theorem proof. Parent sealed replay passes. Its new author-level technical estimates, singular-fibre countermodel and every-subset dimension obstruction leave pinned target A unproved/unrefuted; the branch is parked. [I130](frontier/iterations/i130-spectral-harmonic-discovery.md) passes original I127 N1–N8 at their stated scopes; parent sealed replay passes. It gives technical finite-band harmonic-growth, normalized-exhaustion and geometric escape results, but the one-metric infinite-degree target H remains unproved/unrefuted. [I133](frontier/iterations/i133-fixed-metric-harmonic-growth.md) passes original H1/H2, dilation escape and normalization bounds without repairs; parent sealed replay passes. It constructs a stronger technical exhaustion obstruction with a common core and uniform AVR tail but divergent normalized harmonic-growth constants. Countable curvature scheduling does not pay increasing-cutoff exact matching; H is unproved/unrefuted and parked. [I136](frontier/iterations/i136-birational-positivity-discovery.md) finds that the standalone I133 I.5 growth criterion omits finite initial weighted norm; its literal implication fails, while the corrected criterion and common-core obstruction remain separate. Parent sealed replay passes. Its bounded-index common complement, mixed-jet sufficient class and subset-convex weighted class are technical; the diffuse weighted-nef target remains unproved/unrefuted. [I139](frontier/iterations/iteration139-diffuse-weighted-positivity-task.json) audits these originals and develops nonlinear weighted-jet and point-collision routes. [I91](frontier/iterations/i91-finite-cat0-obstruction.md) passes the used I89 contraction prerequisites without repairs and proposes explicit finite CAT(0) contraction constants via fixed-scale geometry and a 29-point rational certificate. Parent evidence and exact certificate replay pass. [I95](frontier/reviews/i95-finite-cat0-obstruction-r2.md) passes the original Q91 proof and action-to-certificate implication without repairs; parent evidence and independent reconstruction pass. [I96](frontier/reviews/i96-finite-cat0-obstruction-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full Q91 theorem as technical through a complete source-operation reduction and a 12-point scalar contradiction; parent evidence replay passes and I95 resolves its proof condition. [I98](frontier/iterations/i98-complex-kahler-discovery.md) records author-level technical finite-radius and relative complete-spray constructions, with parent evidence replay passing. The arbitrary K3-family Oka-map target remains unproved and unrefuted; [I102](frontier/iterations/i102-relative-k3-oka-construction.md) passes original A98/W98 and both method obstructions without repairs, at the precise reduced-space interpolation scope. Parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible whole-central-slice germ, conditional relative sewing and adaptive exhaustion criterion remain technical; the fixed-domain extension is missing and R98 is parked unproved and unrefuted. [I104](frontier/iterations/i104-modular-representation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical equivariant subsection/trace identities, an all-length A5 divisibility estimate, and explicit obstructions to forgetting Frobenius descent data. Parent evidence replay passes; the blockwise Galois Alperin weight target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I108](frontier/iterations/i108-galois-tuple-divisibility.md) passes all original I104 claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. [I110](frontier/iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes the original finite-moment criterion and constrained-puncture/index claims without repairs; parent replay passes. New exact fixed-label reconstruction, 56 finite moment certificates, a uniform A5×A divisibility bound for odd-order abelian A, and equivariant nontrivial local-point pairing are technical partials. Arbitrary admissible cancellation and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted; the trivial local-point component is unpaid and the branch is parked. [I114](frontier/iterations/i114-quantum-information-discovery.md) gives author-level technical thermal-balance trace-distance estimates and an energy-controlled logarithmic information-loss bound. Parent evidence replay passes. Unequal-temperature constrained entropy power stability remains unproved and unrefuted: the direct entropy-to-balance step is not established there, and the linear-qEPI deficit is positive even at its thermal optimizer. [I117](frontier/iterations/i117-bosonic-entropy-stability.md) passes original I114 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work proves same-input deficit transfer and finite-energy optimizer uniqueness. Exact-constraint rare tails disprove both weighted and ordinary deficit-to-balance moduli and exclude power exponents above 1/2. [I120](frontier/iterations/i120-thermal-trace-stability.md) passes all original I117 analytic claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new author-level technical theorem gives an explicit double-logarithmic trace-distance bound on the original finite-energy constraint set. A direct entropy-growth remainder and a fully constrained displaced-tail test leave every possible power exponent at most 1/2 unresolved. [I123](frontier/iterations/i123-thermal-production-stability.md) passes all original I120 paid claims without repairs, preserving the conditional scope of the production implication; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work resolves the nonsmooth entropy-growth measure and constructs an exact-constraint higher-moment obstruction. Varying the auxiliary instrument exposes a filter/frequency tradeoff but no power bound. Target B remains unproved/unrefuted and the thermal branch is parked pending a new coercivity mechanism. [I126](frontier/iterations/i126-random-geometry-discovery.md) passes original I123 without repairs at its stated scopes; parent sealed replay passes. Its author-level technical replacement criterion and normalized random-tilt entropy bound prove the actual joint FK curve/occupation limit for sufficiently shrinking disorder. Fixed positive disorder still lacks microscopic calibration and replacement. [I129](frontier/iterations/i129-disordered-fk-occupation.md) passes original R126/R1/E126/E3 without repairs but fails the literal endpoint-only R2 cutoff formulation; an explicit [0,1] correction is separate. Parent sealed replay passes. Its new author-level marked-response and posterior identities remain technical; fixed-disorder G is unproved/unrefuted and parked. [I132](frontier/iterations/i132-discrete-probability-discovery.md) passes original I129 paid claims at scope and preserves the literal cutoff failure; parent sealed replay passes. Its sparse-kernel conditional classification and exact planted matrix quotient laws are technical. Full singularity classification remains unproved/unrefuted and is parked. [I135](frontier/iterations/i135-complex-analysis-discovery.md) passes original I132 paid assertions without repairs at scope; parent sealed replay passes. Its uniform subpower endpoint gauge, boundary-measure weak bound and exact one-map critical-point tails are technical. The universal logarithmic Brennan endpoint remains unproved/unrefuted and is parked. [I138](frontier/iterations/iteration138-nonlinear-dynamics-discovery-task.json) audits these deductions before fresh limit-cycle, billiard-rigidity and reaction-network discovery. [I99](frontier/iterations/i99-quantitative-arithmetic-patterns-discovery.md) gives author-level joint-kernel estimates, sharp transfer obstructions and a coefficient-explicit counting bridge; parent evidence replay passes. Its uniform nonlinear Roth target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I101](frontier/iterations/i101-two-scale-nonlinear-roth.md) passes original A1–A5/B1–B4 and the scoped counterexamples without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its short-window graph bounds, actual parabolic matrix comparison and block-conditioned counts remain technical. C99 is parked unproved and unrefuted pending the precise deterministic block comparison (U). [I107](frontier/iterations/i107-rational-tail-attachment.md) passes all original [I105](frontier/iterations/i105-chromatic-homotopy-discovery.md) claims without repairs and supplies an author-level full proof of R105: the actual rational tail splits under F4 and over V for every p≥5 and allowed choice, retaining the nonzero middle attachment. Parent evidence replay passes. [I111](frontier/reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) passes every component of the original full proof without repairs, including the uniform limit, actual detector injection and under/over compatibility, and independently confirms its technical disposition. Parent evidence replay passes; R105 is technically closed under the stipulated premises and no finding is added. [I113](frontier/iterations/i113-online-optimization-discovery.md) gives an author-level technical one-sample matroid-prophet guarantee of 2⁻²⁹⁵K⁻²⁷ under two-sided likelihood-ratio misspecification, one-sided impossibility examples, and exact stochastic Blackwell policy extraction. Parent evidence replay passes. [I116](frontier/iterations/i116-robust-prophet-continuation.md) passes every original I113 component without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its new 1/(2K) local-filter bound concerns offline optimum, while its conditional and thinning counterexamples block specific methods. [I119](frontier/iterations/i119-one-loss-online-selection.md) passes original I116 without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical results sharpen offline filtering to 1/(K+1) and prove an online 1/[α(K+1)] guarantee for bounded positive weight spread. Weighted safe-rank accounting still leaves an aggregate pivotal and scale-allocation gap. The general c/K online target remains unproved/unrefuted and both arbitrary-weight routes are parked. [I122](frontier/iterations/i122-variational-free-boundary-discovery.md) passes original I119 without repairs, including the weighted chain; parent evidence replay passes. Its fresh Dini-coefficient singular-packing target remains unproved. Local radial-defect and conditional covariance estimates, an exact coordinate-change subclass and scoped examples are author-level technical results; the local monotonicity mechanism is already in current literature. [I125](frontier/iterations/i125-dini-singular-packing.md) passes the original partial claims at their stated scopes except the literal general-Λ logarithmic equality, whose missing scale factor is recorded separately. New author-level clearing, compactness, conditional summation and calibration estimates leave ordinary-Dini geometric regularity and the complete packing argument unpaid; Screen C is parked. The original sealed verifier fails inventory ordering; a separate parent ordering-only replay passes with every sealed byte unchanged. [I128](frontier/iterations/i128-statistical-learning-discovery.md) passes original I125 at its stated scopes and preserves both failures; parent sealed replay passes. Its author-level local quadratic stability, exact production surplus and entropy-to-coordinate bridge leave global randomized binary-summary stability unresolved. [I131](frontier/iterations/i131-soft-summary-stability.md) passes the original I128 paid assertions at their stated scopes; parent sealed replay passes. New technical results include accumulated joining losses, soft compression, spike-tolerant local L2 stability and an independent-selector bound. Actual Chen v2 is compared, preserving historical v1. Global S128 remains unproved/unrefuted and is parked pending coordinate selection. [I134](frontier/iterations/i134-discrete-geometric-optimization.md) passes original I131 at its stated scopes; parent sealed replay passes. Its quantitative Gaussian-energy-to-local-cell estimates, including finite-window density and boundary charges, and scoped slow-wave/two-grain obstructions are technical. [I137](frontier/iterations/i137-crystalline-coherence.md) passes original I134 assertions without repairs at scope, including its displayed constants; parent sealed replay passes. Its growing-scale triangular atlas, finite periodic singular-pair budget and exact near-collision obstruction are technical. Coherent interfaces and infinite-volume defect-preserving screening remain unpaid and parked. [I140](frontier/iterations/iteration140-nonlinear-elliptic-discovery-task.json) audits these originals before fresh nonlinear elliptic discovery. Two further substantial findings are needed.

**Eight substantial findings accepted; two remain.** [R014](findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) passes both independent gates and parent reproduction. [C66’s original proof passes](reviews/i67-logarithmic-blowup-r2.md), but [I68](reviews/i68-logarithmic-blowup-novelty.md) classifies it as technical only; its exactly explained parent-wrapper hash failures remain preserved. [I71](iterations/i71-global-variation-algebra-rounding.md) gives a linked strict-local-maximum obstruction and a cap-preserving spectral stopping certificate, with parent evidence PASS. AR remains unproved and unrefuted; further work needs a new global selection/stopping mechanism. [I70](iterations/i70-symplectic-geometry-discovery.md) leaves arbitrary-prefix relative ball packing unproved and unrefuted; its small-ball complement partial has fixed volume slack and is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I73](iterations/i73-arithmetic-geometry-discovery.md) records two incomplete constructions for minimal rank in polynomial twists, with parent provenance and finite-interface PASS; no substantial result is nominated. [I75](iterations/i75-polynomial-twist-selmer.md) independently audits the used prerequisites and gives a forced finite Selmer class, a one-level local-relaxation bound, the Gaussian restriction pairing loss, and actual rank-zero and sparse positive-rank twists. Parent reproduction passes; density and mean targets remain open and the branch is parked. [I72](iterations/i72-graph-probability-discovery.md) pays finite-switch symmetry and the entropy cost of rare girth conditioning but leaves the conditional spectral input open; its percolation extension is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I76](iterations/i76-logarithmic-girth-spectra.md) proves clean and fixed-positive-disorder spectra universality under logarithmic-girth conditioning and the stipulated premises. The clean proof uses rejection absorption and a weaker spectral interface with a log-determinant replacement for full rigidity. [I78](reviews/i78-logarithmic-girth-spectra-r2.md) passes both original proofs without substantive repairs; parent reproduction passes. [I79](reviews/i79-logarithmic-girth-spectra-novelty-r3.md) classifies A, B and the package as technical, with a concrete reduction to existing lower proof operations. Parent reproduction passes; the proof-verified spectral extension does not enter the substantial count. [I74](iterations/i74-relative-symplectic-packing.md) independently passes the used I70 arguments and constructs restricted transport and protected comparison models, with parent evidence PASS. Arbitrary relative packing remains open and is parked pending an adapted global construction. [I77](iterations/i77-weighted-switch-mixing.md) pays weighted pair-slice comparison and a complete matching-subclass flow, while two actual local counterexamples block unchanged weighted source estimates. Parent reproduction passes. The all-degree target is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new aggregate or encoding argument. [I85](reviews/i85-compact-solenoidal-computation-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs, including all-degree pressure cancellation, small-angle gates, loading, global derivative/support budgets and effective evaluation. Parent evidence reproduction passes. I85 resolves the original-proof condition; no finding is added. Parent reproduction preserves the frozen verifier’s inventory-order failure and passes its separate read-only ordering correction with all sealed bytes unchanged. The equivariant geometric and sharp cap-scale targets remain unresolved. [I81](iterations/i81-diophantine-approximation-discovery.md) completes a Diophantine gap report with author-level technical Catalan bounds and parent evidence PASS; finite irrationality measure remains unproved and unrefuted. [I83](iterations/i83-catalan-finite-measure.md) passes original I81 A/B and its conditional criterion without repairs. Its actual integer forms still lack bounded-block noncoincidence; the specified hypergeometric clearing grows at every fixed parameter, while a sufficient gcd saving remains unproved. Parent evidence reproduction passes. C81 is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new mechanism. [I82](iterations/i82-measured-group-operator-discovery.md) gives an author-level polynomial finite-row trace-randomization theorem, classified technical, and precise ergodic-cost and abstract-isomorphism gaps. Parent evidence reproduction passes; no independent analytic verdict is claimed. [I84](iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) passes the original I82 sequence-algebra criterion without repairs and gives an author proof of abstract nonisomorphism for all positive source parameters. Its characteristic essential ideal and trace representation make arbitrary automorphisms spatial after fixed amplification, preserving the original tensor obstruction. Parent evidence reproduction passes.
